main_findings.interpretation: Within this one profiled pass, copy.py contributes about 56.47 percent of exclusive function time and relation_names.py about 16.74 percent. These are profiler-distorted diagnostic shares, not validated unprofiled bottleneck fractions. Profiling wall time is about 2.859 times plain wall time. No optimization speedup follows from these measurements.

scope: Standard-library-only saved JSON audit. No project modules imported and no producer, propagation, detector, profiler, timing or oracle run. Historical clocks were not remeasured; previous exact-oracle certificates were not reverified. Complete semantic identities inherit their prior bound successful checks. Full exported function/caller references, per-scene snapshot count/time coverage, global/stratum sums, by-module partitions and top rankings were reconstructed. Caller tuple interpretation is inherited from the frozen exporter and its tests; unavailable in-memory raw cProfile tuples were not independently re-exported.
